description: ROM Ali Item Drop Spawner, 8-Slot Allocation Probe, Input Ring Sampler & Master Button Dispatcher

routines.name: ali_item_drop_spawn
routines.purpose: Allocates world entity type 8 for item drop with 60-frame timer, clones player coordinates, and returns to idle/walk 0x62CC

routines.name: ali_item_drop_reject
routines.purpose: Plays full bag / drop rejection buzzer SFX 0xC00255 with state 0x3C and anim 0x44

routines.name: ali_item_slot_probe
routines.purpose: Scans 8 entity slots at $FF2ABC (stride 90 bytes) against table 0x05CE16 to verify drop eligibility

routines.name: ali_input_ring_sample
routines.purpose: Samples and ORs composite button masks across d0 frames from input ring buffer at $FF1668 with wrap 0x7E

routines.name: ali_master_button_dispatcher
routines.purpose: Evaluates 5 recent input frames and dispatches Jump (bit 6), Attack (bit 4), Latched Attack ($FF165E), and Spirit (bit 5)
